intervals.label: collaboration: antihydrogen production run on LEAR
intervals.note: Production over "a period of three weeks" in September 1995 (CERN press release of 4 January 1996). End: LEAR "was closed in 1996" (CERN Courier, 17 August 2000); PS210's own last run date is not stated.
intervals.quote: In September 1995, Prof. Walter Oelert and an international team from Jülich IKP-KFA, Erlangen-Nuernberg University, GSI Darmstadt and Genoa University succeeded for the first time in synthesising atoms of antimatter from their constituent antiparticles.

intervals.label: collaboration: completed
intervals.note: Completion is taken as the closure of LEAR; the collaboration's own end date is not stated.
intervals.quote: When CERN's low-energy antiproton ring (LEAR) was closed in 1996 after more than 10 years of operation
